description: Validation of George's AI reading of the DTP signal configuration sheets (task 3C). Automatic checks on all sites, a random re-read sample, error rates per field group and the fixed decision rule applied. Our readings: pipeline/reference/signal_sheets_reread.txt; htm sheets' timing tables are text and are parsed directly.

items.timings: one (phase, field) value: min green, max extension green, yellow, all red, special all red (0 == blank for special all red)
items.phases: the V.A. sequence (letters only) + the non-pedestrian signal-group set of each phase; a phase the AI left empty is wrong
items.pedestrians: one (ped, field) value: walk, clearance 1, clearance 2 (0 == blank for clearance 2)
items.lane_layout: one lane of one approach the AI listed: use class must match, arrows too where drawn; missing/extra lanes are wrong; approaches we could not read are not compared

rule.missing_ai_value: a value on the sheet that the AI left empty counts as wrong

sample.method: random.Random(seed): 2922 + one of 2902/2903/2904/2909, topped up to >= 12 lane_layout sites, rest from all sites with a sheet
